text:
alex (SRE): Quick proposal — I'd like to pilot a lightweight 'follow-through sprint' for postmortems. Idea: a 10-business-day window after a postmortem where every remediation has an owner, a 3-point timeline (Triage, Fix, Verify), and a single weekly 30m sync until closure.

Priya: sounds good. can you sketch the tracker fields?

alex (SRE): Sure — minimal fields only so it doesn't turn into a todo graveyard. Here's the snippet I used in my head: ```owner, priority (P0/P1/P2), due_date (YYYY-MM-DD), status (triage/in-progress/blocked/verify/closed), verification_notes, linked-incident, recurrence_flag``` Keep owner + due_date required.

Jordana: +1. Suggest adding a "regression/risk" flag and a quick root-cause bucket (infra/runtime/config/third-party) so we can spot patterns across cases.

Marta: happy to pilot for the next two incidents from SRE side. I'll run the first weekly sync and take notes. Who should be invited to that 30m?

alex (SRE): Invite owners + incident commander (if different) + one product/infra SME. Keep it small. The sync agenda: 1) quick status updates (3m each), 2) blockers and help needed, 3) any emergent regression signals.

Priya: how do we handle recurring incident patterns? can the tracker surface them?

Jordana: if we tag bucket+service+time-window we can run a simple query weekly to surface repeating buckets. e.g., service=cache, bucket=eviction, count>2 in 30d => escalation review.

alex (SRE): Good. Also propose a subtle change to IC rotation: current rotation is monthly; propose shifting to "on-call-adjacent" rotation where ICs are 6-week slots with overlap week for handoff. That gives continuity for follow-ups. Thoughts?

Marta: overlap week is golden. prevents 'lost open actions' when IC changes mid-remediation. +1 from me.

Priya: is there any automation we can add? maybe a bot reminder and stale-action alerts?

ops-bot: automated message: "Reminder: 3 open postmortem actions >7 days. Run /pm-check to list."

alex (SRE): Exactly — ops-bot can ping owners with 48h and 7d reminders. We'll add a 'stale' state transition after 14 days and auto-assign review owner (rotating) if stale.

Jordana: one process nit: keep closure verification light. Require a 1-paragraph verification note and the related metric/dashboard link. Otherwise teams never mark things closed.

Marta: i'd like checklist items for verification: smoke test steps + dashboard link + deploy link (if applicable).

Priya: can we template the weekly sync meeting invite body so it's copy/paste?

alex (SRE): Yes — here's a tiny template you can paste into invites:

"Weekly PM Follow-Through — Agenda:
- 3m quick status per action owner
- 10m blockers and help needed
- 10m triage for any new recurrence signals
- 5m next steps and owners"

Jordana: timeline expectation: triage within 48h, fix planned within 7 days for P1/P0, verify within 3 days post-fix for non-blocking items. We should set realistic SLOs.

alex (SRE): I'll draft a short playbook doc with the tracker template + meeting invite body + IC overlap proposal and share it in #eng-sre tomorrow. Marta, can you run the pilot for incidents 3872 and 3879?

Marta: yes, will do. starting next Monday.

Priya: thanks — if the pilot looks good, we can push a repo template and ops-bot scripts to automate reminders.

alex (SRE): thanks all. Next steps: 1) alex will post the playbook draft in #eng-sre (by EOD tomorrow), 2) Marta pilots and reports back after 2 follow-through sprints, 3) ops-bot schedule for reminder messages (engineering to pick up).

ops-bot: automated message: "Note: Added label 'follow-through-pilot' to incidents 3872, 3879."
